content: Compatibility of ConcreteClassTailoring s ConcreteClassTailoring s are compatible if both the consumer and producer consider the related class as not relevant. (i.e. ConcreteClassTailoring . in- Scope ==false). They are incompatible if the values of ConcreteClassTailoring . inScope are different. Further analysis is required if both the consumer and pro- ducer consider the related class as relevant. (i.e. ConcreteClassTailoring . in- Scope =true). See also table 8.45.
